UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public-safe authenticated gardener profile stored under /users/{userId} without PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

preferredTheme.description: User's persisted UI theme mode for day or night-time gardening.

preferredLanguage.description: User's persisted UI language preference across up to five supported languages.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

DiseaseDiagnosis.title: DiseaseDiagnosis
DiseaseDiagnosis.description: AI-powered plant disease detection result and treatment record owned by a user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the diagnosis.

pathogenType.description: Type of pathogen or physiological issue.

treatmentSteps.description: Bounded list of structured treatment steps (max 10).

organicTreatment.description: Bounded list of biological and organic remedies (max 10).

chemicalTreatment.description: Bounded list of targeted plant protection options (max 10).

farmerNotes.description: User symptoms note or treatment progress note.

thumbnailDataUrl.description: Compact compressed JPEG preview thumbnail of the analyzed plant photo.

followUpDays.description: Recommended follow-up check interval in days.

WeatherPreference.title: WeatherPreference
WeatherPreference.description: User's extreme-weather alert thresholds, garden coordinates, and push notification preferences stored at /weatherPreferences/{userId}.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

autoPushEnabled.description: Whether extreme weather push notifications are enabled.

heatThresholdC.description: Extreme heatwave trigger threshold in Celsius (30..45).

rainThresholdMm.description: Heavy rain/storm trigger threshold in mm (5..200).

windThresholdKmH.description: High wind gust trigger threshold in km/h (15..120).

coldThresholdC.description: Frost/cold snap trigger threshold in Celsius (0..20).

city.description: Selected region or garden locality name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preference was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preference was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/diagnoses/{diagnosisId}.description: AI plant disease diagnoses and treatment records owned by authenticated users.

/weatherPreferences/{userId}.description: Extreme weather threshold and push alert settings owned by authenticated users.
